goal: Convert the existing CS2 Demo Anomaly Lab into a durable project vision, retire the old working source, and rebuild a fresh candidate through the reviewed Provider route under bounded Codex supervision.
acceptance_criteria: A Markdown and machine-readable vision preserve required capabilities, prohibited claims, and acceptance boundaries before the old generated directory is removed.
Only generated/cs2_demo_anomaly_lab_20260814 is retired; artifacts and formal candidates remain preserved.
A validated capability-supervisor brief guides a fresh reviewed-Provider run without authorizing source writes or delivery itself.
The fresh output uses a new isolated identity, does not reuse retired source, and stops within the bounded Provider request budget.
Generated tests, cached-real-Demo runtime, packaging, and delivery are evaluated only if a candidate materializes.

quality_metrics.measure: fresh Provider source executes from parser through report
quality_metrics.target: a new candidate passes tests and one cached real Demo produces a valid report
quality_metrics.method: reviewed Provider generation, isolated pytest, and local CLI runtime probe

quality_metrics.target: no cheating verdict or ban authorization without labels and corroborating information telemetry
only the reviewed Provider writes candidate source and only local_packager may deliver after gates pass
quality_metrics.method: Provider phase log, source identity, and delivery evidence review

prevention: Seal the product vision and exact retired-source hashes before deletion.
Use a four-item librarian packet instead of loading all historical CS2 runs.
Freeze typed interfaces, truth assertions, a 24-request ceiling, and no-retired-source reuse before generation.
assurance: Validate the capability-supervisor request, response, brief, and authority boundaries.
Keep vision, generation, runtime, and delivery evidence independent.
control: Verify the exact deletion target and preserve a recoverable retirement receipt.
Start a fresh Provider run with one worker and monitor Provider requests.
Stop when a hard Provider allowance blocker makes further local fallback work non-authoritative.
improvement: Resume the same frozen run only after a reviewed credential has usable Provider allowance.

interface_expectations: The durable vision is product memory; retired source structure is not generation authority.
The Codex supervisor may diagnose and define acceptance but does not write the Provider candidate.
Only authorized Demo files may be analyzed and no unlabeled sample authorizes a cheating verdict or ban.
No management or supervisor artifact authorizes formal delivery PASS.

feedback: The old 101-file working project was converted into validated Markdown and JSON vision artifacts, then removed to the Windows recycle bin; historical artifacts and formal candidates were preserved.
The bounded supervisor handoff completed and a fresh output identity entered the reviewed Provider route without retired-source reuse or candidate edits.
The initial 180-second total deadline expired before a Provider request; the same frozen checkpoint was then resumed with a corrected total deadline.

The explicit resume issued three Provider requests and all three returned provider_key_usage_limit. Zero component leaves completed, no candidate materialized, and packaging and delivery were not invoked.
PB-021 remains active because a usable reviewed Provider credential is required to continue the same frozen run.

worked: Durable vision and hash-bound retirement evidence separated product intent from disposable generated source.
Single-worker monitoring exposed the hard Provider allowance blocker after only three requests and prevented indefinite local fallback work.
No candidate, package, delivery manifest, or unsupported anti-cheat conclusion was fabricated.
did_not_work: The first command treated 180 seconds as the whole generation deadline rather than a per-request timeout and produced only planning artifacts.
The configured Provider credential immediately returned provider_key_usage_limit on every resumed request, so no generation leaf completed.
experiments: After a reviewed credential has allowance, resume artifacts/cs2_demo_anomaly_lab_rebuild_20260820/run with the same frozen plan, retain single-worker monitoring, and compare completed leaves and prompt characters before increasing the 24-request ceiling.
